questions.q: Who were the sons of Levi?
questions.a: Levi’s sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Kohath?
questions.a: Kohath’s sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

questions.q: Who were the children of Amram, and who were the sons of Aaron?
questions.a: Amram’s children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam, and Aaron’s sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

questions.q: What was true about the priest Azariah, whom Johanan fathered?
questions.a: He served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

questions.q: To whom did Yahweh exile Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.a: Yahweh exiled Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Levi in this second list?
questions.a: Levi’s sons were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Gershom?
questions.a: Gershom’s sons were Libni and Shimei.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Kohath in this list?
questions.a: Kohath’s sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Merari, and what did this list begin?
questions.a: Merari’s sons were Mahli and Mushi, and this began the list of the clans of the Levites by their fathers.

questions.q: Who were the sons of Samuel?
questions.a: Samuel’s sons were Joel, the firstborn, and Abijah, the second.

questions.q: What were the duties of the men whom David put in charge of music?
questions.a: They were to serve by singing before the tabernacle.

questions.q: Who built the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem?
questions.a: Solomon built the house of Yahweh.

questions.q: Who was Heman, and who were his father and grandfather?
questions.a: Heman was a singer descended from Kohath. His father was Joel, and his grandfather was Samuel.

questions.q: Who was Samuel’s ancestor, going back to Amasai?
questions.a: Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah, Zuph, Elkanah, and Mahath were Samuel’s ancestors, going back to Amasai.

questions.q: Who was Amasai’s ancestor, going back to Israel?
questions.a: Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah, Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah, Izhar, Kohath, and Levi were Amasai’s ancestors, going back to Israel.

questions.q: Who was Asaph’s ancestor, going back to Levi?
questions.a: Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, and Gershom were Asaph’s ancestors, going back to Levi.

questions.q: Who was Ethan’s ancestor, going back to Levi?
questions.a: Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, and Merari were Ethan’s ancestors, going back to Levi.

questions.q: What tribe of Israel was assigned to do the work for the tabernacle?
questions.a: The Levites were assigned to do this work.

questions.q: What atonement offerings were Aaron and his sons responsible for?
questions.a: They were responsible for the offerings on the altar for burnt offerings and on the incense altar.

questions.q: What were these offerings for?
questions.a: These offerings were to ask Yahweh to forgive Israel’s sins.

questions.q: Which descendants of Aaron received land first, and how did they receive it?
questions.a: The descendants of Aaron who belonged to the clan of Kohath received land first, by lot.

questions.q: What city and land did the descendants of Aaron receive, and who received the fields and villages around it?
questions.a: They received the city of Hebron in Judah with its pasturelands, but Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, received the fields and villages around the city.

questions.q: What other cities did the descendants of Aaron receive, along with Hebron?
questions.a: They also received Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth Shemesh, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Aaron receive from the tribe of Benjamin, and how many cities did they have in all?
questions.a: They received Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth from the tribe of Benjamin, and they had 13 cities in all.

questions.q: How many cities did the rest of the descendants of Kohath receive, and from where?
questions.a: They received ten cities by lot from the half tribe of Manasseh.

questions.q: How many cities did the descendants of Gershom receive, and from which tribes?
questions.a: They received 13 cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

questions.q: How many cities did the descendants of Merari receive, and from which tribes?
questions.a: They received 12 cities by lot from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

questions.q: Where did the Levites live because they were not given specific land like the other tribes?
questions.a: The Levites were assigned by lot cities with their pasturelands from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

questions.q: Which tribe gave cities to some of the clans of Kohath?
questions.a: Some of the clans of Kohath received cities from the tribe of Ephraim.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Kohath receive from Ephraim and the surrounding area?
questions.a: They received Shechem, a city of refuge, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth Horon, Aijalon, and Gath Rimmon, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the rest of the descendants of Kohath receive from the half tribe of Manasseh?
questions.a: They received the cities of Aner and Bileam, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Gershom receive from the half tribe of Manasseh?
questions.a: They received Golan in Bashan, and Ashtaroth, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Gershom receive from the tribe of Issachar?
questions.a: They received Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Gershom receive from the tribe of Asher?
questions.a: They received Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Gershom receive from the tribe of Naphtali?
questions.a: They received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the rest of the descendants of Merari receive from the tribe of Zebulun?
questions.a: They received Rimmono and Tabor, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities east of the Jordan did the descendants of Merari receive from the tribe of Reuben?
questions.a: They received Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, with their pasturelands.

questions.q: Which cities did the descendants of Merari receive from the tribe of Gad?
questions.a: They received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, with their pasturelands.

commentary.text: —We have an account of Levi in this chapter. The priests and Levites were more concerned than any other Israelites, to preserve their descent clear, and to be able to prove it; because all the honours and privileges of their office depended upon their descent. Now, the Spirit of God calls ministers to their work, without any limit as to the families they came from; and then, as now, though believers and ministers may be very useful to the church, none but our great High Priest can make atonement for sin, nor can any be accepted but through his atonement.
